page.overview:
Who is Aisha Raveneos?

Aisha Raveneos was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She was stout and had soft, brown eyes. She was a plain-faced woman who wore wore a wealth of jewelry, earrings with large firedrops, long necklaces of both emeralds and rubies, but only the golden Great Serpent for a finger ring.

She was reputed to "adhere to the strictest letter of the law no matter her own feelings, whether pity or contempt".

With a level of , she was very strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai.
